arms.name: A2
arms.what: A again, a second independent read (the reader's own run-to-run noise)

arms.name: G
arms.what: v19.1 with handwritten rule 4's 'If you are marking more than ~20% of words as unclear, you are being too cautious' removed, and one line added to the handwritten rules: 'Never replace a word you cannot read with a likelier or more familiar word, name or number. Mark it <unclear>…</unclear> with what you can see.'

readers: the two served first readers, each its own pair: lite (Batch) and 3flash via agy; same pages for A, A2, G
draw: stratum H: 40 hard-hand manuscript pages, one per book, from books whose served page drew an invented/misread note (Latin MS excluded if #7947 has switched it to Opus); stratum P: 30 clean print pages, one per book, Latin/German/French print, where the extra <unclear> marks would show up as lost readable text

noise_floor.from: A vs A2 on the same pages

judges.role: blind, image attached; on stratum H every 'invented' call on G and A read by eye on 10 pages

outcomes: H: wrong-text (invented or substituted) spans per page, G minus A, against the A2 minus A spread
P: readable words lost to <unclear> per page and accept rate (must not drop)
decision: Adopt G only if, on stratum H, G's invented spans per page fall below A by more than A2-A noise for BOTH readers, and on stratum P accept does not fall by more than 0.05 and readable words marked unclear rise by under 2%. If G only moves words into <unclear> without cutting invented spans, reject: the prompt is not the lever and P1 is.
cost: 70 pages x 3 arms x 2 readers = 420 reads (lite Batch under $1; 3flash on the agy subscription) + about 420 Opus judgings on the subscription + by-eye reads
